status.why: Draft / proposed fits an initiative with no stored evidence of any later stage

date_published.why: 2026-09-09 is the Gaceta Parlamentaria publication date on the SIL page. The text itself says 'Dado en la sede del Senado de la República a los 08 días del mes de septiembre de 2026' (signing date, in notes). Either is defensible; the Gaceta date is the presentation date in the Senate.

official_identifier.why: null is right: neither stored copy gives a Gaceta or bill number; the SIL matter number is not a citable bill number

date_in_force.why: null: transitory article 1 sets entry into force the day after DOF publication, which has not occurred

summary_claims.claim: Creates a Secretariat of AI and Digital Future; amends Organic Law of Federal Public Administration (Art. 26, 38 Ter)
Bans manipulative, exploitative, harmful systems and mass biometric identification not allowed by law (Art. 58 I, II, III, IV, VI)
Secretariat may order audits and temporarily suspend systems posing grave risk (Art. 61 III, V)
Initiative signed by 21 PAN senators; 22 chapters; unemployment insurance; 90/180 day deadlines
summary_claims.locator: page 1; Capitulo XXII, p. 81; transitory articles pp. 81-82

scope.note: AI-specific general law initiative with risk management, prohibitions and supervision; no scope_note needed. Distinct from MX-01 (Sen. Ruiz Ruiz, February 2026).

note: Fields supported by the stored 90-page PDF (text layer) and the SIL page; I verified title, 21 signatories, Articles 57-61, transitory articles and the signing line. Not a duplicate of MX-01. A web search found no later stage or referral. The committee referral is unknown, so Draft / proposed rests on absence of evidence of anything later, which is the normal reading for a bill filed a month ago.
